value.rationale: The theorem exactly classifies a natural and highly symmetric family of incenter loci. A drastic shift from an 11-dimensional set of maximum-ball centers for \(d=4\) to a unique center for \(d=5\) despite increasing ambient dimension is a genuine uniqueness transition. Walsh-degree support identifies all permissible infinitesimal and finite center motions, and the facet-contact spectrum has independent geometric meaning. This is not simply a recomputation of the radius or a small unmotivated enumerated case.
